==Notes==
This template is one in a series of modular source templates meant to be used to generate box-style navigation templates. It is meant to be [[m:Help:substitution|substituted]] and will not work properly if 'subst:' is not present in the template call.

==Usage instructions==
<pre>{{Nav box end}}</pre>

===Optional parameters===
#{{Para|edit}} The name of the navigation template in which this template is transcluded.

==Box-style navigation source templates==
*{{Tl|Nav box start}}
*{{Tl|Nav box heading}}
*{{Tl|Nav box}}
*{{Tl|Nav box end}}

==Example==
===Code===
<pre>
{{Nav box start|Navigation template test}}
{{Nav box|The 1st box is the deepest}}
{{Nav box|2 Boxy 2 Blurious}}
|-
{{Nav box|3 blind boxes}}
{{Nav box|Box box BOX bOX}}
{{Nav box end}}
</pre>

===Result===
{{Nav box start|Navigation template test}}
{{Nav box|The 1st box is the deepest}}
{{Nav box|2 Boxy 2 Blurious}}
|-
{{Nav box|3 blind boxes}}
{{Nav box|Box box BOX bOX}}
{{Nav box end}}
